title: Play uploaded GIF slideshow after clicking Yes and show “I love you Himani Chauhan”

requirements.text: Update the acceptance/success screen shown after clicking the “Yes” button so it plays the two uploaded GIFs (img3.gif and img1.gif) as a looping animation/slideshow (one after another), instead of the current static meme image.

quotes: I want to play these two pictures after I click on yess button
Ye rebuild it and play these pics as animation

acceptanceCriteria: From the main Valentine prompt screen, clicking the “Yes” button navigates to/shows the success view.
The success view displays a looping slideshow using the two uploaded GIFs: img3.gif and img1.gif.
The slideshow shows exactly one GIF at a time and automatically transitions to the next on a timer; after the second GIF it loops back to the first.
The GIFs are referenced as static assets from the frontend (not served via the backend), and render correctly in production build.

requirements.text: On the success screen, display the text exactly as: “I love you Himani Chauhan” (in English), placed beneath the GIF animation area.

quotes: I love you के साथ लिख देना हिमानी चोहान

acceptanceCriteria: The success screen includes the text “I love you Himani Chauhan” exactly (spelling and spacing as shown).
The text appears beneath the GIF slideshow and remains readable on both mobile and desktop screen sizes.

requirements.text: Preserve the existing Valentine prompt behavior when rebuilding: the initial page shows “Will you be my Valentine?” with “Yes” and “No” buttons, and clicking “No” progressively increases the size of the “Yes” button without breaking layout.
acceptanceCriteria: The prompt page still shows the Valentine question and both “Yes” and “No” buttons.
Clicking “No” continues to increase the “Yes” button size progressively, capped as currently implemented.
No new regressions: the prompt page remains usable on mobile and desktop (buttons remain tappable/clickable and not clipped off-screen).

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose them instead).
Do not edit frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, or frontend/src/main.tsx (immutable paths).
Backend must remain single-actor; no additional backend services.
nonGoals: Adding new authentication or user accounts.
Persisting user choices or slideshow state to the backend.
